name: Battle Turret X-13 seat can vent Blowin' off Steam to knock enemies back (#11302)
contract: Build: Battle Turret X-13 504680 summons Battle Turret X-13 457772, a vehicle the Tinker or a raid member enters
through gossip. Live combat logs from 2026-08-29 show the turret casting Blowin' off Steam 503606, an energy-100
knockback of every enemy within 10 yards, after it builds up steam. The seat may only cast spells on the creature's
creature_template_spell list, so 503606 must be on that list for the knockback to reach the vehicle bar.

steps.label: Let the spawn and level scaling settle
Place a Battle Turret X-13 next to the Tinker
Let the turret script finish its summon setup
Enter the turret through its gossip
The Tinker controls the turret seat
The enemy stands inside the 10-yard steam radius
The turret builds up a full 100 steam
Vent Blowin' off Steam from the seat
The turret casts Blowin' off Steam
The steam knocks the enemy out of the 10-yard radius
